title: CloudEventEnvelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope with mandatory clrinf extension attributes.

source.description: URI identifying the producer service (e.g. clrinf/stok-satinalma)

subject.description: Subject of the event in the context of the event producer (e.g. order/ORD-12345)

time.description: Timestamp when the event was generated (ISO 8601 UTC)

datacontenttype.description: Media type of the event data

correlationid.description: Correlation identifier spanning across entire workflow

causationid.description: Event ID that directly triggered/caused this event

is_error.description: Optional flag identifying an error event

is_compensation.description: Optional flag identifying a compensation event
